scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @workspace/validation run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/db run build && tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @workspace/validation run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/db run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @workspace/validation run build && tsx --test src/store-management/*.test.ts src/catalog-management/*.test.ts src/master-catalog/*.test.ts src/customer-management/*.test.ts src/customer-marketplace/*.test.ts src/customer-cart/*.test.ts src/orders/*.test.ts
